title: Common definitions
description: Primitive types shared by every substrate schema. I/O contract Appendix A: "Field types: `id` ULID, `ts` ISO-8601 UTC, `digest` sha256 hex, `rev` integer." §2: "All identifiers are ULIDs minted by the owning service; source-native identities (Saga run ids, harness session ids, workspace pane ids, archive record ids) are preserved in bindings, never used as a universal identity." Patterns use the common subset of RE2 and Python re; `$` means end of string (see README.md).

ulid.description: ULID: Crockford base32, uppercase, 26 characters. All Odin-minted ids.

ts.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp with a literal Z; optional 1 to 9 fraction digits.

evidence_ref.description: A reference to evidence held elsewhere (Appendix A `evid:...`).

ref.description: Correlation key (§3 `ref`): run:<id>, request:<rid>, review:<rid>, approval:<approval id>, work:<name>, commitment:<id>, prompt:<id>; identities, never content digests.

src.description: Producer identity (§3 `src`): operator:telegram:<chat_id>, operator:terminal, operator:<surface>, odin, mimir, mimir:<position>, run/<id>, saga, eir-webhook, work:<name>, bragi, host, host:<id>, capture, surface:<sensor>.

wake_class.description: Wake class assigned at intake: §4's four classes interrupt, wake, log (log only) and state (state only), plus none. `none` is Odin's provisional addition in I0: not one of §4's four classes; the in-code handling marker (handled in code; no planner turn by default).

subject_ref.description: A typed reference to another Odin record. Each record narrows `kind`.

record_ref.description: A record id with the revision it was read at (e.g. the Environment a binding was opened under).

usage.description: Usage of a model turn or review position. §12: "Log request/model/configuration ids, input, output and cache usage, latency, retries and priced cost; unavailable fields stay unknown." Every key is optional; `unavailable: true` marks a position or call that did not run (AC-22).
